We use your date of birth for safety con.af: Ons gebruik jou geboortedatum vir veiligheidskontroles. Voeg dit by sodat ons die regte instellings kan toepas. As jy 18 of ouer is, kan jy hierdie skakelaars verander nadat jou datum gestoor is. Tieners van 13–17 hou bestuurde instellings.
We use your date of birth for safety con.zu: Sisebenzisa usuku lwakho lokuzalwa ezilawulini zokuphepha. Lungeza ukuze sikwazi ukusebenzisa izilungiselelo ezifanele. Uma uneminyaka engu-18 noma ngaphezulu, ungashintsha lezi zikhwishi ngemva kokulondolozwa kosuku. Intsha eneminyaka engu-13–17 igcina izilungiselelo ezilawulwayo.
We use your date of birth for safety con.xh: Sisebenzisa umhla wakho wokuzalwa kwiilawuli zokhuseleko. Yongeza ukuze sikwazi ukusebenzisa iisetingi ezifanelekileyo. Ukuba uneminyaka engama-18 nangaphezulu, ungaziguqula ezi zivitshi emva kokuba umhla ugciniwe. Ulutsha oluleminyaka eli-13–17 lugcina iisetingi ezilawulwayo.
We use your date of birth for safety con.st: Re sebelisa letsatsi la hau la tsoalo bakeng sa taolo ea polokeho. E kenye hore re ka sebelisa litlhophiso tse nepahetseng. Haeba u le lilemo li 18 kapa ho feta, u ka fetola li-switch tsena ka mor’a hore letsatsi le bolokoe. Bacha ba lilemo tsa 13–17 ba boloka litlhophiso tse laoloang.
We use your date of birth for safety con.nso: Re šomiša letšatši la gago la matswalo bakeng sa taolo ya polokeho. E tsenye gore re ka šomiša dipeakanyo tše di nepagetšego. Ge o na le mengwaga ye 18 goba go feta, o ka fetola diswitšhe tše ka morago ga ge letšatši le bolokilwe. Bafsa ba mengwaga ye 13–17 ba boloka dipeakanyo tše di laolwago.
We use your date of birth for safety con.tn: Re dirisa letsatsi la gago la matsalo bakeng sa taolo ya tshireletso. E tsenye gore re ka dirisa dipeakanyo tse di siameng. Fa o na le dingwaga tse 18 kgotsa go feta, o ka fetola diswitšhe tse morago ga gore letsatsi le bolokilwe. Banana ba dingwaga tsa 13–17 ba boloka dipeakanyo tse di laolwang.
We use your date of birth for safety con.ts: Hi tirhisa siku ra wena ra ku velekiwa eka swilawuri swa vuhlayiseki. Swi engetela leswaku hi nga tirhisa swilunghiselelo leswi faneleke. Loko u ri ni malembe ya 18 kumbe ku tlula, u nga cinca swi-switch leswi endzhaku ka ku hlayisiwa ka siku. Vantshwa va malembe ya 13–17 va hlayisa swilunghiselelo leswi lawuriwaka.
We use your date of birth for safety con.ve: Ri shumisa ḓuvha ḽau ḽa u bebwa kha zwilawuli zwa tsireledzo. Zwi engedzeni uri ri kone u shumisa nzudzanyo yo tea. Musi ni na miaka ya 18 kana u fhira, ni nga shandukisa zwiswitshi izwi nga murahu ha u vhulunga ḓuvha. Vhaswa vha miaka ya 13–17 vha vhulunga nzudzanyo i tshi langwa.
We use your date of birth for safety con.ss: Sisebentisa lilanga lakho lekutalwa etilawulini tekuphepha. Ngeta kute sikwati kusebentisa tilungiselelo letifanele. Uma uneminyaka legu-18 noma ngaphezulu, ungashintja leti tikhwishi ngemuva kwekugcinwa kwelilanga. Bantfu labasha labaneminyaka legu-13–17 bagcina tilungiselelo letilawulwako.
We use your date of birth for safety con.fr: Nous utilisons votre date de naissance pour les contrôles de sécurité. Ajoutez-la afin d’appliquer les bons réglages. Si vous avez 18 ans ou plus, vous pourrez modifier ces interrupteurs une fois la date enregistrée. Les 13–17 ans conservent des réglages gérés.
We use your date of birth for safety con.ar: نستخدم تاريخ ميلادك لأدوات السلامة. أضفه لنطبّق الإعدادات المناسبة. إن كان عمرك 18 عاماً أو أكثر يمكنك تغيير هذه المفاتيح بعد حفظ التاريخ. يستمر المراهقون 13–17 بإعدادات مُدارة.

Money from online payments, after Beauto.zu: Imali ezinkokhelweni ze-inthanethi, ngemva kwekhomishini ye-Beautonomi, noma yisiphi isikhathi sokubamba, kanye nezinkokhelo osuziceliwe. Ukheshi nokukhokha ngomshini wekhadi okuthathe wena akuhlanganisiwe. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ibhizinisi lakho lonke, hhayi igatsha elilodwa.
Money from online payments, after Beauto.xh: Imali kwiintlawulo ze-intanethi, emva kwekhomishini ye-Beautonomi, nasiphi na ixesha lokubamba, kunye neentlawulo osuziceliwe. Imali nentlawulo ngomatshini wekhadi ozithathele wena ayibandakanywa. Oku kuhlanganisa ishishini lakho lonke, hayi isebe elinye.
Money from online payments, after Beauto.st: Chelete e tsoang litefong tsa inthanete, ka mor’a khomishene ea Beautonomi, nako efe kapa efe ea ho ts'oara, le litefo tseo u li kopileng. Chelete le tefo ea mochine oa karete eo u e nkile ka seqo ha e kenyeletsoe. Sena se akaretsa khoebo ea hau eohle, eseng lekala le le leng.
Money from online payments, after Beauto.nso: Tšhelete go tšwa ditefong tša inthanete, ka morago ga khomišene ya Beautonomi, nako efe goba efe ya go swara, le ditefo tše o di kgopetšego. Tšhelete le tefo ya motšhene wa karata ye o e tšeere ka bowena ga e akaretšwe. Se se akaretša kgwebo ya gago ka moka, e sego lekala le tee.
Money from online payments, after Beauto.tn: Madi a a tswang mo ditefong tsa inthanete, morago ga khomišene ya Beautonomi, nako epe ya go tshwara, le ditefo tse o di kopileng. Madi le tefo ya motshini wa karata e o e tsereng ka wena ga e akarediwe. Se se akaretsa kgwebo ya gago yotlhe, e seng lekala le le lengwe.
Money from online payments, after Beauto.ts: Mali eka swihakelo swa inthanete, endzhaku ka khomišene ya Beautonomi, nkarhi wihi na wihi wo khoma, na swihakelo leswi u swi kombelaka. Mali na xihakelo xa muchini wa khadi lexi u xi tekeke hi wena a xi katsiwi. Leswi swi katsa bindzu ra wena hinkwaro, ku nga ri ntlawa wun’we.
Money from online payments, after Beauto.ve: Masheleni a bva kha mbadedzo dza inthanete, nga murahu ha khomisheni ya Beautonomi, tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tsha u farwa, na mbadedzo dze na khumbela. Tshelede na mbadedzo ya mutshini wa khadi ye na i dzhia nga inwi a i dzheneiswi. Izwi zwi kuvhanganya bindu ḽau ḽoṱhe, hu si tshigwada tshithihi.
Money from online payments, after Beauto.ss: Imali etinkhokhelweni te-inthanethi, ngemuva kwekhomishini ye-Beautonomi, noma nguliphi sikhatsi sekubamba, kanye netinkhokhelo losuticeliwe. Imali nekukhokha ngemshini wekhadi lokutsatsile wena akufakiwe. Loku kufaka libhizinisi lakho lonkhe, hhayi ligatja linye.
Money from online payments, after Beauto.fr: Argent des paiements en ligne, après la commission Beautonomi, toute période de retenue et les versements déjà demandés. Les espèces et paiements par terminal que vous avez encaissés vous-même ne sont pas inclus. Cela couvre toute l’activité, pas une seule succursale.
Money from online payments, after Beauto.ar: أموال المدفوعات عبر الإنترنت بعد عمولة Beautonomi وأي فترة احتجاز والمدفوعات التي طلبتها. النقد ومدفوعات جهاز البطاقة التي استلمتها بنفسك غير مشمولة. يشمل ذلك نشاطك كله لا فرعاً واحداً.
